authority: Latest author explicitly confirms Deadpool, Magneto and all other roster characters who are not dead can meet the Sins again and/or members of Noxus roster, with other independently plausible contacts.
rule: Completed first encounter only prevents replay as a first encounter. It does NOT retire a living person from the ongoing world or require a single appearance. Living roster members can reencounter the Sins, TPP, Noxus native cast, fellow crossovers and other established parties repeatedly, whenever there is actual geographic access, motive, knowledge and causal opportunity. Meetings can lead to cooperation, conflict, attraction, deals, grudges, support, indifference or departure according to free agency.

examples.Deadpool: E19 introduction/payment completed, but Deadpool remains eligible for new scenes and return encounters with the Sins, TPP, Noxians or other crossover people; no repeated arrival speech.
examples.Magneto: E30 bridge/refugee meeting completed; he can return independently after actual travel/decision and meet the gang again or Noxian leaders/other characters. He is not permanently attached to the refugees or excluded by the 'completed' status.
examples.Baldur: Alive after E22/E26 evidence. Future sourced meetings possible without mandatory rematch or curse resolution.
examples.Kratos: Alive after E26, may meet again through actual travel/choice, no compulsory duel.
examples.Tai_Lung: Defeated alive E13, may act and encounter again as his wounds/location allow.
examples.Other: Every other living selected source-native or crossover actor remains open to recurring interactions, including Noxus-on-Noxus and crossover-on-crossover encounters.

limitations: Retain actually dead characters' death status, including Heimdall. Do not resurrect without separate author authority.
Respect explicit temporary author nondeployment, such as Briar offstage; alive doesn't override a specific current hold.
No forced meeting schedule, cameo quota, predetermined battle/win, free teleportation or instant actor knowledge.
Each return builds on previous meeting, injuries, memories, alliances, insults, property and consequences.
A plan is not a delivered event; E32 paused, no story time advanced.
